data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate increased net technical reserves by GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 1.5m) as a result of deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 262.747m. The Syndicate reported an increase in prior year technical reserves (net) of GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years in 2019, driven by deteriorations arising on a whole account quota share with AXA XL (adverse claims development and reinsurance recoveries impact). No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the movement note, so the reported net movement has been used.

as a result of deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL

data.data_quality_notes: The notes explicitly state a NET prior year reserve increase of GBP 8.8m (page 15). No clear gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' insurance-liabilities (gross) figure was located in the notes accessible; a gross claims development triangle exists (page 21) but its printed alignment in the provided images made reliable automated extraction of the full prior-year gross movement ambiguous. Per instructions, the explicit NET figure has been used and flagged here. If a gross movement table is provided elsewhere in full quality text, that should be used instead.
